highlights.title: Remind only the households still waiting
highlights.body: Send a reminder to just the households that have not replied, with each one's private reply link included.

highlights.title: See your whole weekend on the Overview
highlights.body: The Overview opens with your countdown, the Hebrew date, and every time and venue for the weekend. Copy the schedule to send to family.

highlights.title: Guests reply from a private link
highlights.body: Each household gets its own link. No account, no password. Replies wait for your approval before they change your list.
